caption:
Nobody tells you this when you set up custom instructions.

You spend 20 minutes writing what feels like a great prompt. "I'm a marketing manager. I like concise answers. Bullet points are great."

And then... the AI is still kind of mid.

Here's why: you described your job title. Not how you think.

There's a massive difference between telling ChatGPT *what you do* and telling it *how your brain works*.

For ChatGPT → Settings > Personalization > Custom Instructions
For Claude → Profile settings > Custom Instructions
For Gemini → Extensions panel > Customize Gem

All three have the field. Almost nobody fills it out right.

Instead of "I work in finance," try:
"I need the tradeoffs laid out before the recommendation. Don't tell me what to do until I've seen the options. I'll ask follow-up questions — don't anticipate them."

That's not a job description. That's a thinking pattern.

BootFile exists because this is genuinely hard to write about yourself. We figure out your thinking style and translate it into instructions these models actually understand.

The field is there. Most people just don't know what to put in it.
